verdict.rationale: Payout reconciliation is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. The pack never documents itemized transaction or fee reports, or any way to reconcile takings against payouts. The payouts doc only describes funds being sent to a bank account, and the analytics and unified-Dashboard items are adjacent features, not reconciliation reporting.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports
